artworks.title: La femme. Je viens de découvrir une mèche...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, a man and a woman. The man is gesturing with one hand while holding a comb over his head. He has dark, medium-length hair styled to one side and a mustache, wearing a light, loose-fitting long-sleeved shirt and patterned trousers. The woman is facing the man, leaning slightly forward, with dark hair pulled back into a bun. She is wearing a dark dress with fitted sleeves and a lighter-colored apron or underskirt. The background resembles a wall with simple repetitive motifs, suggesting an indoor setting.

artworks.title: Je te le dis toujours, avec ton sucre...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two people, a man and a woman. The man is holding what looks like an umbrella or walking stick, and is dressed in a long coat, pants, and shoes. He has a narrow face with pronounced cheekbones and a long nose, and his hair is visible under a top hat. The woman wears a bonnet, a long dress, and a shawl, and her face is round. They are walking a small dog on a leash. The background has a textured pattern resembling a faint outline of a page or newspaper.

artworks.title: Arthur, vous m'aviez promis un trône...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals, a man and a woman, shown from approximately mid-torso up. The woman is seated or positioned slightly behind the counter with her hands not visible, while the man is leaning against the counter with one arm resting on it and a handkerchief hanging from his other hand. The woman has a long neck, closed eyes, and distinct facial features with her hair styled in large curls or buns on either side of her head. She wears a dark dress with a low neckline adorned with buttons. The man has a stern expression with a prominent nose and chin, and his hair is graying and slicked back. He is dressed in a dark suit with a light-colored cravat around his neck. Behind them, there is a simple backdrop with some faint decorative patterns, and the top portion of the image includes text which reads "Moeurs Conjugales" (Conjugal Morals) in French, suggesting a newspaper or publication format. The overall tone of the image is monochrome, with an emphasis on line and shading.

artworks.title: Ça n'empêche que ça vaut encore mieux....
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two elderly individuals sitting on vintage armchairs. The man on the left wears a dark robe and a nightcap, while the woman on the right wears a light-colored robe and bonnet. They both have serene expressions and relaxed facial features. The woman holds a small dog, and there is a bird cage with a bird inside hanging on the wall. A large bird perches nearby. In the background, there is a wooden table with a glass-domed display and decorative items. The setting appears to be an interior room with textured walls and elegant furnishings.

artworks.title: Lolo!...veux-tu laisser la chaisse tranquille...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring four figures in an interior setting. The room includes furniture and decorations. One person sits on the edge of a sofa, watching as another figure is pushed over by a small figure pulling at a chair leg, causing the chair holder to lose balance. The room has classical décor with a mantelpiece holding a small statue or ornament. The characters show exaggerated expressions and postures, adding a lively element to the scene.

artworks.title: Pardon, Mr Le Maire! ... pourriez-vous ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: In the image, a man is seen barefoot on the shore pointing towards someone swimming in the water. He is engaged in conversation with an elegantly dressed man and a woman in period clothing. The setting is near a river or a large body of water, with the swimmer partially visible in the background. The swimmer's attire contrasts with the formal clothing of the man and woman on shore, adding a humorous element. The style and clothing suggest a possible 19th-century setting.

artworks.title: L'enseignement mutuel
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures in water, with most of their upper bodies visible. The central figure has curly hair and is gripping the edge of a wooden structure. This figure has a unique physical feature with an exaggerated back or buttocks. Their facial features include wide, expressive eyes and an open mouth. The figure appears to be speaking or startled. They are wearing a tight-fitting garment that covers the upper body. Surrounding this figure are several other individuals, including two children who are partially submerged and appear to be swimming or floating nearby. One of the children is blowing bubbles. In the background, there are additional figures with legs dangling over the edge of the wooden structure. The environment has a sketch-like quality with visible textured lines indicating wood and water, with a slightly surreal and whimsical atmosphere.

artworks.title: Poids et mesures
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two women standing facing each other in profile. The woman on the left is hunched slightly forward with her arms crossed over her abdomen. She has a prominent nose and is wearing a cap and a long dress or coat with a shawl draped over her shoulders. The woman on the right looks surprised, with her mouth slightly open and large eyes. She is wearing a bonnet, a long-sleeved dress, and a textured apron tied around her waist, holding a folded piece of cloth or paper. Both are standing on a cobblestone pattern with a simple background.

artworks.title: Le lecture du charivari
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two individuals engaged in reading a large newspaper together. The drawing depicts a scene where two figures are closely inspecting a newspaper titled "Le Charivari". The paper is large and appears to cover most of their bodies. One figure is wearing a top hat and is primarily visible due to this distinguishing feature. The other figure, shown in profile, seems to have spectacles. The newspaper itself features text and small illustrations, with the prominent text appearing in French. The artwork captures the characters in a humorous or satirical moment, common in the style of illustrations typical of 19th-century caricature.

artworks.title: Un jour de fête et de bretelles
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, one standing facing forward with wavy hair and a long-sleeved garment, and the other in a side profile wearing a headscarf and long-sleeved dress. The individual on the left appears to be adjusting a pair of embroidered suspenders around the neck of the person on the right.

artworks.title: Une visite a l'atelier
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two people looking at a framed artwork. The image presents an intimate scene where two individuals appear to analyze a piece of art on a decorative easel. The artwork within the frame depicts a landscape with a house and a figure. The setting might be an artist's studio, as indicated by the presence of a painting palette held by one of the figures. Text below the image includes French dialogue and is part of a series titled "Les Beaux Jours de la Vie."

artworks.title: Un triomphe d'avocat
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two people engaged in a close interaction. One person is kissing the other on the cheek, who appears surprised. Both individuals have distinct facial features, with one holding a small object. A hat is placed to the right on a surface, while faint outlines of other faces or figures are seen in the background. Surrounding the scene is a text overlay with the title "LES BEAUX JOURS DE LA VIE."

artworks.title: Un soir de fête nationale
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an illustration with three figures caught in a storm. The figures are huddled together, one using a cloth to shield themselves from the rain. The drawing features expressive, caricature-like figures in a rainy setting with faint outlines of structures or fireworks. The text above and below hints at social or cultural commentary typical of prints from the 19th century.

artworks.title: Un paiement de dividende
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a man depicted from the knees up, positioned upright, facing forward, with his hands held together at his waist. The man has distinct facial features with a surprised expression, wearing small round eyeglasses. He is wearing a tall black top hat, a dark suit, and a high-collared white shirt. There is a grid-like pattern in the background with text reading "CAISSE." Another man is visible behind a grille in the background.

artworks.title: L'anniversaire du mariage
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image displays a man and a woman facing each other. The woman is holding a sheet of paper, wearing round spectacles and a bonnet. She is dressed in a striped dress with a shawl. The man is seated, looking at the woman, with a friendly expression. He is wearing a shirt, waistcoat, and jacket. The background is simple, emphasizing the figures. French text at the bottom seems related to an anniversary theme.

artworks.title: Un nouvel anobli
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a caricature of two men from the waist up. The man on the left has a raised eyebrow, a slightly open mouth, a long nose, and slicked-back hair. The man on the right leans forward slightly, has a pointed nose, and wears a coat with a prominent collar and white cravat. Both men wear suits with light waistcoats and white shirts. The background has vertical shaded lines resembling curtains or shadows, suggesting an indoor setting. French text above the figures reads "LES BEAUX JOURS DE LA VIE."

artworks.title: Aux Champs-Elysées
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elderly man seated at a table with a woman standing beside him, holding a guitar. The man appears to be smiling or smirking, leaning back slightly in his chair. His hand rests on a small table with a few small coins or objects. The woman holds a guitar, with her head tilted back and her mouth open. The scene captures a moment of musical enjoyment or performance. The drawing is in a monochrome style, characteristic of traditional etching or lithography, with cross-hatching and line work to convey texture and depth.

artworks.title: C'est bien aujourd'hui 28 Juillet ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting up in bed holding a book or an almanac. He has a pointed nose, a slightly wrinkled face, and a firm expression. He wears a nightcap and a loose-fitting nightshirt. Beside him, a woman lies covered and sleeping, with only her face visible. The bed is covered with a simple blanket. The background includes heavy shading, possibly curtains or a canopy, creating a dim, nighttime atmosphere indoors.

artworks.title: Hotel de la Marine
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image is a drawing depicting two men from the knees up. The man on the left is in profile, standing upright and facing slightly toward the other man while holding a sheet of paper. He appears to be wearing a dark coat and knee-length breeches with stockings. He has short hair, parted to one side with a prominent brow. The man on the right faces the left man with an exaggerated pose, leaning slightly backward and has a plump form. He is wearing traditional Chinese attire with a topknot hairstyle. His clothing is loose-fitting, consisting of a long-sleeved garment and simple footwear. Behind them is a detailed background that includes a decorative screen. There is no visible jewelry or additional objects being held by either man in the scene.

artworks.title: Fumeurs et priseurs
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts four men indoors. The man on the far right looks surprised with his mouth open and hands near his face. The second man from the right is seated and wears a cap. The third man holds a pipe with smoke and wears a patterned robe. The man on the far left has a bald head and appears seated. The background is shaded with crosshatched lines. The image is monochromatic and sketch-like.

artworks.title: La leçon de musique
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three caricatured figures in a music lesson scene. The central figure is sitting with a horn instrument, wearing a hat and traditional Chinese clothing. To the right, another figure with a bald head and braid is visible. A third figure is partially seen on the left with a surprised expression. The background is a textured, shaded wall, and the scene is illustrated in monochrome with a French caption at the bottom.

artworks.title: Les mandarins lettrés
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: In this image, a group of six individuals is gathered around a table, with their entire upper bodies visible. They are seated, resting their arms and heads on the table, and several appear to be asleep or yawning. Their faces exhibit exaggerated expressions, with prominent cheekbones and brows, and they have distinctive hairstyles, some with topknots. The clothing is traditional, with flowing robes, and there are books and papers scattered on the table in front of them. One of the individuals has a cap on their head. No jewelry is apparent, but books and papers are notable objects in the scene. The background is a textured wall with a subtle pattern.

artworks.title: Comment on passe ses soirées en chine
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts four people seated at a round table. They are engaged in a game, with one person holding cards and game pieces visible on the table. Each individual has a unique appearance and is wearing traditional attire. The background shows a plain, shaded wall.

artworks.title: Le premier jour de l'an
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures engaging in a traditional greeting which involves a kiss. The figures are depicted in a caricature style with exaggerated features and expressions. They are dressed in traditional clothing and have distinct hair styles. The background has a textured design. The artwork portrays an intimate cultural scene.
